A '''firebomb''' was an incendiary explosive used by rioters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. [[Premier]]e [[Jan Dovu]], planetary leader of Kabal during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], was killed when a firebomb detonated near him during the riots.
